scout.brief: BRIEF MODE: Focus ONLY on: (1) Project type and tech stack, (2) 2-3 most relevant files to modify, (3) One critical pattern if any. Skip comprehensive exploration. Keep JSON output minimal - just essential fields. No need for exhaustive file listings.
scout.moderate: MODERATE MODE: Gather focused context - project type, 5-10 relevant files with their purposes, key patterns to follow, main internal dependencies. Standard exploration depth with essential details only.
scout.thorough: THOROUGH MODE: Full exploration - complete project analysis, comprehensive file listing with relevance scores, all detected patterns, full dependency mapping (internal and external), detailed risk assessment, integration points.

architect.brief: BRIEF MODE: Minimal design - list 1-3 components with file paths and actions only. Skip data flow diagrams, skip alternatives analysis. One-sentence approach summary. Get straight to the point.
architect.moderate: MODERATE MODE: Focused design - key components with exact paths, main data flow (3-5 steps), primary technical decision with brief rationale. Standard architecture depth without exhaustive alternatives.
architect.thorough: THOROUGH MODE: Complete architecture - all components with interfaces and responsibilities, full data flow sequence, multiple technical decisions with alternatives and trade-offs, all integration points, open questions, risk areas.

planner.brief: BRIEF MODE: Direct implementation - maximum 5 steps total, single phase, inline code snippets, skip detailed descriptions. No separate testing phase (validation checklist only). Get straight to the actionable steps.
planner.moderate: MODERATE MODE: Structured plan - 2-3 phases, 5-10 steps with proper dependencies, code snippets for each step, basic testing strategy with key test cases. Standard implementation depth.
planner.thorough: THOROUGH MODE: Comprehensive plan - multiple phases (setup, core, testing, cleanup), detailed steps with full code, explicit dependency graph, parallel execution markers, complete testing strategy with edge cases, validation commands.

validator.brief: BRIEF MODE: Quick validation - check only critical items (every step has action + target + code). Skip pattern compliance checks, skip style warnings. Pass threshold: 70. Brief summary only.
validator.moderate: MODERATE MODE: Standard validation - all checks at normal severity thresholds. Pass threshold: 80. Include key warnings and recommendations.
validator.thorough: THOROUGH MODE: Deep validation - all checks at strict thresholds, detailed warnings for every issue, pattern compliance verification, code quality assessment. Pass threshold: 90. Comprehensive summary with all recommendations.

synthesizer.brief: BRIEF MODE: Simple merge - combine sub-plans linearly, skip dependency graph visualization, minimal execution notes. Focus on getting a working plan.
synthesizer.moderate: MODERATE MODE: Structured synthesis - proper phasing across sub-features, clear inter-feature dependencies, basic parallelization hints where safe.
synthesizer.thorough: THOROUGH MODE: Complete synthesis - detailed phasing with rationale, ASCII dependency graph, risk areas highlighted, comprehensive integration notes, rollback considerations.
